title: Berta Estate Hub App
description: A comprehensive property management solution simplifying billing, payments, and complaint handling for tenants and estate managers.
detailedDescription:
Berta Estate Hub is a robust property management ecosystem designed to bridge the gap between tenants, estate managers, and finance teams.


Core Goals:

  • Improve tenant satisfaction: Simplify billing and payments via a user-friendly mobile app.
  • Streamline Operations: Reduce manual reconciliation time for finance staff.
  • Enhance Transparency: Provide digital receipts and real-time ticket tracking.

The platform consists of two main components: a Tenant Mobile App (iOS/Android) for managing bills, utilities, and complaints, and a powerful Admin Web Dashboard for estate managers to oversee operations, billing, and reporting.


Our team worked closely with stakeholders to identify key challenges and opportunities. Through a combination of innovative technology and strategic planning, we were able to deliver a solution that not only met but exceeded expectations. The project has set a new benchmark for efficiency and sustainability in the sector.

modules.title: Tenant Mobile App
modules.description: Allows tenants to view/pay service charges, buy meter units, track complaints, and manage their profile. Features a digital wallet and secure Flutterwave payment integration.

modules.title: Admin Web Dashboard
modules.description: A centralized hub for Estate Managers and Finance Officers to manage tenants, create service charges, reconcile payments, and view analytics.

modules.title: Smart Billing & Payments
modules.description: Automated billing for service charges and utilities. Supports manual bill creation, recurring templates, and instant digital receipts via Flutterwave.
